StepSplit bundles these OCR components:

- Tesseract.js 6.0.1: Apache-2.0
  https://github.com/naptha/tesseract.js
- Tesseract.js-core 6.0.0: Apache-2.0
  https://github.com/naptha/tesseract.js-core
- English trained data from tessdata_fast: Apache-2.0
  https://github.com/tesseract-ocr/tessdata_fast

The Apache-2.0 license text is included with each component. The bundled
JavaScript files also include their dependency notices in the adjacent
*.LICENSE.txt files.
